title.en: The Schwarzschild solution and black holes

summary.en: The Schwarzschild solution is the exact solution to the Einstein field equations for the spacetime around any spherically symmetric, non-rotating mass, and it predicts a specific radius — the Schwarzschild radius — at which, for a sufficiently compact mass, spacetime becomes so curved that not even light can escape from within it: a black hole, with the Schwarzschild radius marking its event horizon.
summary.et: Schwarzschildi lahend on täpne lahend Einsteini väljavõrranditele aegruumi jaoks mistahes sfääriliselt sümmeetrilise, mittepöörleva massi ümber, ning see ennustab kindlat raadiust — Schwarzschildi raadiust —, millel piisavalt kompaktse massi jaoks muutub aegruum nii kõveraks, et isegi valgus ei suuda selle seest põgeneda: must auk, mille sündmuste horisondi tähistab Schwarzschildi raadius.
